title: Grateful Dead Live at Knickerbocker Arena on 1991-03-23
lineage: MAC playback on Nakamichi CR-7A with manually adjusted azmimuth > Presonus Firebox Neutrik inputs > Firewire/XP Pro > Wavelab 5, recorded as 24 bit 96 KHz PCM WAV > Waves L3 Multimaximizer (-1.7 dB/-0.1 ceiling > rendered to 16 bit/44.1 KHz WAV using UV22 HR, normal/no autoblack > CDWAV 1.9 > FLAC (level 8)
source: FOB Nak 700s > Sony D5 > Type IV cassette (Maxell MX100s), no Dolby during recording.

ai_review.summary: Audience tape with light bass but clear mids/highs captures a high‑energy winter show marred by vocal flubs and occasional instrumental misses.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience source that sounds reasonably balanced—bass a bit thin while mids and highs are pleasant. The concert itself bursts with winter‑time adrenaline, especially in the first set, but suffers from frequent vocal and instrumental flubs throughout both sets.

ai_rating.rationale: Only two brief reviews; one praises the tape's tonal balance while the other points out many performance slips, leading to a moderate overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Bass slightly light; mids and highs are clear and pleasant. No major distortion or drop‑outs noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as teetering yet exciting, second set similarly energetic; overall performance energetic but riddled with vocal flubs and occasional instrumental misses.
